tenures.note: Paired with Brian McKenzie in the Meltdown main event intergender tag match against Simon O'Neal and Donna Tetreault; the match was lost when Tetreault pinned McKenzie with a small package. Lost a non-title singles rematch against Donna Tetreault by submission (Caress of Steel) on 22 October 2003. Beat Myra Benedict by pinfall (top-rope Arizona Rattler) on 12 November 2003, breaking a two-match losing streak. Lost by pinfall (superkick) to Sierra Browne on 20 December 2003 after landing four straight moonsaults, the last of them into her own raised knees; challenged Marissa Monet to a singles match at Eve of Destruction afterward. Ran in to make the save for Alicia Powers against the Bod Squad on 25 August 2004 without competing. Beat Tara Marshall by disqualification on 28 August 2004 after Marshall struck her with a tag team title belt in front of the referee; saved from a two-on-one beatdown afterward by Alicia Powers. Teamed with Alicia Powers to beat Extreme Measures (Nina Grimsson, Lisa Drake) by pinfall on 22 September 2004, hitting the top-rope Arizona Rattler on Lisa Drake after Powers's own Michinoku Driver. Co-won a women's three-way dance over Brianna Landis and Reona Yoshida on 20 October 2004 after she and Yoshida each locked on a separate submission hold on an unconscious Landis at the same moment, the referee declaring both women winners and awarding each a UWF Women's Tag Team Championship match against the Bod Squad. Cornered Alicia Powers to a submission win over Tesla St. James on 1 December 2004, coaching her through the champion's own signature Red Irish beforehand. Cornered Alicia Powers to a pinfall win over the Bod Squad (Brianna Landis, Tara "Sunburst" Marshall) on 25 May 2005, trading words backstage beforehand with Marshall and a jeering Brianna Landis. Confronted John DeWolfe alongside Lisa Drake and Alicia Powers on 22 June 2005, mocking Tara Marshall and Brianna Landis as "nothing more than a chance" for T&A. Teamed with Alicia Powers as the Wind Walkers in a women's tag match against Amazing Grace and Kari Stevens on 20 July 2005, ruled a no-decision after the Bod Squad interfered. Backed debuting Samantha Daniels and clashed verbally with Kari Stevens backstage on 3 August 2005; lost a six-person tag alongside Alicia Powers and Lisa Drake to the Bod Squad and John DeWolfe by pinfall on 6 August 2005. Teamed with Alex Kidd in the Cupid's Revenge Blind Date Tournament on 14 February 2006, eliminated by Brett Greene's rollup after eliminating Leslie Hernandez.
